label: SpaceXAI
description: SpaceXAI (Grok) API plus the official Grok Build coding agent. Adds SpaceXAI under Providers & Keys and Grok Build under Coding Agents.

walkthrough.title: Set up SpaceXAI and Grok Build

steps.title: Providers & Keys
steps.body: Paste a SpaceXAI key under Providers & Keys, or sign in with `grok login`. Grok Build appears under Coding Agents after the official CLI is installed.
